Subject: Peregrine Systems onboarding — legal entity & remittance worksheet request

Hi Emily —

Welcome aboard — excited to get Peregrine set up so we can start issuing POs. To expedite finance and tax review, can you please complete the attached vendor onboarding worksheet and return with the following items by end of day Friday (7/18):

- Completed vendor worksheet (attached)
- Signed W-9 (or local tax form if non-US)
- Remit-to details: legal entity name, full address, tax ID/EIN, and whether remit is to parent or subsidiary
- Bank instructions: ACH routing & account / wire details + bank letter confirming account name (PDF)
- Registered company legal name, DBA (if any), and business registration number
- Point of contact for invoicing and who should receive POs

Notes on process: we operate on PO-driven purchasing. Once we validate entity and bank details, procurement will create a master PO and send via DocuSign for acceptance. Typical payment terms are Net30; if you have different standard terms please flag them.

For your convenience I uploaded a blank onboarding worksheet here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding-worksheet — please attach completed version in reply.

Thanks — copying Neha (procurement) and Marcus (finance) to assist on any questions.

Best,

Hi Emily —

Quick answers inline:
1) Please provide the invoicing entity that will appear on the invoice. If invoices will be issued by Peregrine Systems, LLC (MA) we need that entity's EIN. If you plan to invoice from the parent entity, we'll need that parent EIN and an authorized DBA declaration.
2) DUNS is not mandatory but it speeds vendor risk checks. If it's under the parent entity, include the DUNS and we’ll reconcile during validation.
3) Email PO acknowledgement is fine. We don't require use of the portal for first-time suppliers; procurement will send the PO PDF and a DocuSign acceptance link for the master terms.

Two small asks from finance to avoid payment delays:
- Please include the bank letter (on bank letterhead) confirming account ownership.
- If you prefer ACH, provide routing+account and a copy of a voided check or bank verification doc.

Also, can you confirm whether Peregrine has any tax withholding exemptions or foreign withholding considerations so Marcus can handle tax set-up?

Thanks — once we have the worksheet + W-9 + bank letter we'll run entity verification and issue the first PO.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Specialist
redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems onboarding — legal entity & remittance worksheet request

Thanks Emily — appreciate the quick turn. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize:

- Please confirm the legal entity exactly as it appears on IRS records and attach the W-9 page that contains the EIN (we need the signature page).
- If you want Net45 instead of our default Net30, state that explicitly and include brief commercial justification; approvals for Net45 are handled by Finance.
- For wires: include intermediary bank (if any), SWIFT/BIC, and beneficiary account name matching the legal entity on the W-9.
- If Peregrine is registered outside the US for any reason, indicate the country and local tax ID — we will need that for tax treaty / withholding rules.

Once we receive the completed worksheet and the bank letter, we'll create the vendor record and send the initial PO. Expect procurement validation to take 1–2 business days after receipt of complete docs.

If it's helpful, I can approve a temporary pre-PO payment hold (internal note) to unblock urgent onboarding — let me know.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Payments & Treasury
